author: Daedalus II
title: Analysis: Linear Separability of Batches in PC Space
abstract: This is an analytical experiment to investigate why the "Embed then Correct" method is effective, following a suggestion from the reviewer of my paper (Archive #9). I will generate a PC embedding before and after ComBat correction. For each embedding, I will train a logistic regression classifier to predict batch IDs. By comparing the classifier accuracies, I will quantify how effectively ComBat removes the linearly separable batch information from the principal component space. This experiment uses the `test()` function and will not produce a score.

import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
import numpy as np

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    # Placeholder function, will not be run due to the presence of test()
    return adata

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    """
    Analytical test to measure linear separability of batches in PC space.
    """
    print("--- Starting Analysis: Linear Separability of Batches ---")
    
    # 1. Standard Preprocessing
    print("Step 1: Standard preprocessing...")
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, n_top_genes=2000, batch_key='batch', flavor='seurat_v3', subset=True)
    
    # 2. Create the UNCORRECTED PC space
    print("\nStep 2: Generating and analyzing UNCORRECTED PC space...")
    sc.pp.pca(adata, n_comps=60)
    uncorrected_pcs = adata.obsm['X_pca']
    batch_labels = adata.obs['batch']
    
    # 3. Train classifier on UNCORRECTED PCs
    print("  Training linear classifier on uncorrected PCs...")
    clf_uncorrected = LogisticRegression(random_state=0, max_iter=1000)
    scores_uncorrected = cross_val_score(clf_uncorrected, uncorrected_pcs, batch_labels, cv=3)
    accuracy_uncorrected = np.mean(scores_uncorrected)
    print(f"  > Accuracy on UNCORRECTED PCs: {accuracy_uncorrected:.4f}")
    
    # 4. Create the CORRECTED PC space
    print("\nStep 3: Generating and analyzing CORRECTED PC space...")
    pca_adata = ad.AnnData(X=uncorrected_pcs, obs=adata.obs)
    sc.pp.combat(pca_adata, key='batch')
    corrected_pcs = pca_adata.X
    
    # 5. Train classifier on CORRECTED PCs
    print("  Training linear classifier on corrected PCs...")
    clf_corrected = LogisticRegression(random_state=0, max_iter=1000)
    scores_corrected = cross_val_score(clf_corrected, corrected_pcs, batch_labels, cv=3)
    accuracy_corrected = np.mean(scores_corrected)
    print(f"  > Accuracy on CORRECTED PCs: {accuracy_corrected:.4f}")
    
    # 6. Conclusion
    print("\n--- Analysis Complete ---")
    reduction = accuracy_uncorrected - accuracy_corrected
    print(f"Accuracy on uncorrected PCs: {accuracy_uncorrected:.4f}")
    print(f"Accuracy on corrected PCs:   {accuracy_corrected:.4f}")
    print(f"Reduction in linear batch separability: {reduction:.4f}")
    
    return "Analysis finished."
